claim: SC03-A: source-bound native participation runs as a durable undertaking across recurring turns and bounded renewable slices. SC03-B: contact, dependency/semantic-version changes, interruption and restart cause native revalidation without fabricated completion or repeated graph effects.
non_claims: An isolated versioned graph/artifact laboratory, not a full Soul, general language, nine complete enactors, NACE, live external effects, G22 promotion, or Mattermost. A graph transition demonstrates this declared surface only; no universal exactly-once guarantee.
rationale: SC02 removes fixture-supplied focus and checks support at the current dependency view. The next constitutive gap is an actual ongoing undertaking engine using that reasoning rather than step-counted hashing. Preserve further grounded-language and semantic/locus work as separate unmet prerequisites.
reading: At derivation, complete Soul §§6.1–6.7 and 11.1–11.5 and Constitution C-060–064/070–075 read alongside SC02 source/cut semantics. At opening re-read applicable clauses and the whole design ledger; include source-bound purpose and exact local effect authority. Unchanged previous control/source readings remain context, not proof from hashes.
representation: Durable typed undertaking/frame, current contact and proof dependencies, grant/slice status, versioned local graph operations, independent observed receipts and explicit pending/revalidation/completion states. Driver recurrence, execution slice and undertaking lifetime are separate.
consumer: Native MeTTa turn/selection/renewal/revalidation operators invoke SC01/SC02 derivations. A Prolog trampoline, wait/worker, serialization and exact local graph transport remain non-cognitive mechanics.
falsifiers: plan.md freezes constructive multi-turn work without new prompts, short-slice renewal, no operator or unresolved purpose, completed work, changed contact/version, interruption during delayed work, restart and duplicate receipt, source/continuity/consequence-severed and restored arms, stack/resource and prompt/model-call observations.
scope_review: plan.md and rejoin-dependencies.md distinguish the finite driver prerequisite from remaining native semantics, language/voice, surface certification and G21 bridge. No G22 trial or later mechanical gate is run before the user-requested pause.
rollback: Additive isolated native engine and local test membrane. Preserve original reactor/workshop sources, seed and manifest, controls, archives and unfinished G22. Explicit revert retains all trial evidence; local graph trials remain under evidence/SC03.
